title: D2P Revision
description: Revision record (document type 'd2p:revision') of one immutable artifact revision (design decision ADR-003). A revision is never edited; undo is a new, compensating revision.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

sequence.description: Position in the artifact's history: 1 if and only if parentRevisionIds is empty, otherwise max(parent sequence) + 1 (checked when the parent records are in the bundle, D2P-REF-007).

parentRevisionIds.description: Parent revisions: empty for the first revision, one for a normal commit; two are reserved for merges.

contentDigest.description: Digest of this revision's artifact content document, excluding that document's own contentDigest member (digest profile d2p-digest-v1). Unlike on other documents, this member does not digest the revision record itself.

commandId.description: Command that produced the revision (used for staleness checks, D2P-REF-006).

lineage.description: Identity changes of elements in this revision (split, merge, replace, remove). Omitted when there is nothing to record.

lineageEntry.title: Lineage entry
lineageEntry.description: One element identity change relative to the parent revision. Old references stay valid against their pinned revision.

fromElementIds.description: Element IDs of the parent revision affected by the change.

toElementIds.description: Element IDs in this revision that result from the change. Empty only for 'remove' (semantic rule, not schema-enforced).
